purpose: Blind forward test. These rules are fixed before any of the data they will be scored on exists. Do not edit this file: to change a rule, add rules_v2 with a new start week and keep v1 scoring.
data: Weekly closes from Yahoo Finance chart API (adjusted). Gold/silver ratio = GC=F / SI=F front-month futures closes.

ratio.cross: previous week's ratio on one side of the line, this week's ratio on or past it
ratio.score: up-cross (silver buy) right if ratio lower later; gold-oz = ratioAt / ratioLater - 1. down-cross (back to gold) right if ratio higher later; gold-oz = ratioLater / ratioAt - 1

bigWeek.score: excess vs SPY = (P_later / P_at) / (SPY_later / SPY_at) - 1; chase warning (up week) right if excess < 0; drop review right if excess < 0

momentum.pass: close above its 40-week average AND close above the close 52 weeks earlier
momentum.score: pass group vs fail group, mean excess vs SPY
